title: Inspect the live durability gate and execute round-trip only when the existing DB linkage is actually present
previous: BRAIN-N018 hardened the live Render gate so missing or invalid DB linkage becomes DENY/PENDING without crashing the service
scope: wait for and inspect latest live deployment
verify DATABASE_URL presence without revealing its value
if linkage exists, run one compact evidence persist/read-back roundtrip
if linkage is absent, record DENY/PENDING and do not mutate secrets blindly
recompute evidence SHA and lineage when roundtrip runs
persist action log and current state
completion_gate: live service reports explicit durability state; if linked, roundtrip survives deployment and SHA/lineage match; otherwise explicit DENY/PENDING is persisted
